question.text: The Forward Contracts Regulation Act (FCRA), 1952 was repealed and replaced by regulation under:

answer.text: Securities Contracts Regulation Act (SCRA), 1956 — with effect from September 28, 2015

explanation.text: The Logic: FCRA 1952 was repealed and regulation of commodity derivatives shifted to SEBI under SCRA 1956 with effect from September 28, 2015. The commodity and securities derivatives markets were subsequently integrated operationally. The Trap: The Companies Act, Banking Regulation Act, and Indian Contract Act do not govern securities and derivatives trading on recognised exchanges. Note: The pages checked do not support the broader claim that this shift unified currency or interest-rate derivatives under one regulator, so the explanation stays with commodity and securities derivatives.
